about: Whether the count of tool calls that open a core file should read each call's whole command instead of the first 300 characters the turn record keeps (16 Nov 2026). Each entry is a call that starts counting when the whole command is read, with the part of the command that names the core file and a verdict: opens core code (reads, edits, compiles or runs a core file), runs only a test folder, runs only a test (a pytest test id), or mentions a core path only in text (none found).
